name: 小糸
text: や、止まないね……！
trans: T-The rain doesn't seem to stop anytime soon....

name: 雛菜
text: そうだね～
trans: Seems like it～

name: 小糸
text:
傘、買っちゃおうか
ここのスーパーで
trans:
Should we buy some umbrellas. 
There's a supermarket over there.

name: 小糸
text: ちょっともったいないけど……
trans: It'd be a waste of money though...

name: 雛菜
text:
あ～
そうする～？
trans: Yeah～, wanna get them～?

name: 小糸
text: う、うん……！
trans: Y-Yeah!

name: 小糸
text:
ここで雨宿りしてても
ただ時間が経つだけだし……
trans:
Even if we wait it out, 
we'd just end up wasting our time.

name: 雛菜
text:
それじゃあ
まずはお菓子見よ～
trans: Okay then, I'm gonna look for some snacks first～

name: 小糸
text:
え……！
傘買って帰るんじゃないの？
trans: Wha...! I thought we are buying umbrellas to go home.

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～
けど、お菓子見てる間に止むかもしれないでしょ～？
trans:
Yea, but the rain might die down while we look for
snacks, right～?

name: 小糸
text: そ、そうかな……？
trans: Y-You really think so...?

name: 雛菜
text:
そしたら傘も買わずに済むし
その分お菓子も買えるよ～？
trans:
Then we won't need to buy umbrellas, and we can use 
that money to buy snacks instead right～?

name: 雛菜
text: だったらその方がお得じゃない？
trans: Doesn't that sounds better?

name: 小糸
text: そ、そうかも……？
trans: When you put it like that...

name: 雛菜
text:
でしょ～？
じゃあカゴ持ってお菓子売り場に──……
trans:
Right～? 
Let's get a basket and head to the snack aisle...

name: 雛菜
trans: ...Oh

name: 小糸
text:
……？
どうしたの？　雛菜ちゃん
trans: ...? What's the matter, Hinana-chan?

name: 雛菜
text:
『雨の日特売
春雨カップスープ』だって～
trans:
They are selling this,
"Rainy Day Special Item: "Harusame Noodle Cup Soup"

name: 小糸
text: あ、ほ、ほんとだね……！
trans: Oh yeah, y-you're right.

name: 小糸
text:
春雨と春雨をかけて
特売してるんだ……ちょっと面白いね
trans:
They are selling "light-as-rain" noodles while it's 
raining outside.... 
It's kinda funny.

name: 雛菜
text:
…………
ね、小糸ちゃん
trans: ........ Hey, Koito-chan.

name: 雛菜
text:
食べる方の春雨って
なんで春雨って言うの？
trans: Why do they call the harusame noodles "spring rain"?

name: 小糸
text:
え……
ど、どうしてかな……？
trans: Eh...? I-I wonder it myself.

name: 小糸
text:
麺が雨っぽいからじゃないかと思うけど……
た、多分……
trans:
I think it's because the noodles looks like the rain. 
P-probably.

name: 雛菜
text:
なんだ
小糸ちゃんもちゃんと知らないのか～
trans: Oh, not even you know～

name: 雛菜
text:
ま、別に
そこまで気にならないからいいけど
trans: Well, I'm not that curious about it anyway, so it's fine.

name: 雛菜
text: あは～、調べてる～？
trans: Aha～, are you looking it up right now?

name: 小糸
text:
だ、だって……！
気になるし……
trans: T-That's because... I am curious about it...

name: 小糸
text:
わかんないこと、わかんないままにするのって
よくないよ
trans:
It's not good to leave things you don't know, 
unexplained.

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～
そう～？
trans: Hm, you think so～?

name: 小糸
text: そ、そうだよ……！
trans: Y-yeah!

name: 雛菜
text:
そっか
だから小糸ちゃん頭いいのかもね～
trans: I see. That's why you're so smart, Koito-chan～

name: 小糸
text:
え、えへへ
そうかな……
trans: E-ehehe. I wouldn't really say that.

name: 小糸
text:
べ、別に
普通だけどね……！
trans: I-I feel like it is normal thing to do.

name: 小糸
text: えっとね……
trans: Let me see here...

name: 小糸
text:
春雨は、『麺の白く細い様子が春の雨に似ていることから
名付けられた』……だって！
trans:
It says here that Harusame noodles were named like 
that because "the thin, white appearance of the 
noodles resembles spring rain."

name: 小糸
text:
こういう麺自体は昔からあったけど、『春雨』って
呼ばれ始めたのは割と最近のことみたいだよ……！
trans:
It looks like they have existed for a very long time, 
but people only have called it "spring rain" noodles 
quite recently.

name: 小糸
text:
ちょっと、雛菜ちゃん
聞いてる？
trans: Wait, Hinana-chan. Are you listening right now?

name: 小糸
text: せっかく調べたのに……！
trans: Why did I even look it up for...?

name: 雛菜
trans: Mhmm....

name: 小糸
text:
……ひ、雛菜ちゃん
そんなに買うの？
trans: Hinana, are you going to buy that many snacks?

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～
だって食べるでしょ～？　みんな
trans: Yea～, everyone is going to eat all of these, right?

name: 雛菜
text: 透先輩の家に置いとけば
trans: If I leave these at Toru-senpai's place.

name: 小糸
text:
ぴぇ……
と、透ちゃんのお家に置いとくの？
trans:
Pyeh... 
Y-you're planning to leave these at Toru-senpai's 
place?

name: 雛菜
text: 小糸ちゃんだってあれば食べるでしょ～？
trans: You would eat it too if it's there right～?

name: 小糸
text: そ、それは……！
trans: Well...

name: 小糸
text:
…………
そうかも、しれないけど……
trans: .... Well, you might be right.

name: 雛菜
text:
でしょ～？
透先輩何味がいいんだっけ～
trans:
Right～? 
So what flavor of snacks does Toru-senpai 
like again～?

name: 雛菜
text:
しょうゆか、塩か
コンソメか～……
trans: Soy sauce, salt, or maybe consome～

name: 小糸
text:
え、えっと……
なんだろう？
trans: U-um... Which ones should we pick?

name: 小糸
text: 聞いてみるね……！
trans: I'm gonna ask her...!

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～
別にわざわざ聞かなくてもいいけど……
trans:
Huh～, I mean you don't need to really need to ask 
her about it though...

name: 雛菜
text:
……あ、でも
よくないんだっけ
trans: Oh, but, that wouldn't be good, would it?

name: 雛菜
text: わかんないこと、わかんないままにするの
trans:
It's not good to leave things you don't know,
unexplained.

name: 小糸
text:
うん
そうだよ……！
trans: Yea, that's right!
